subject: Intro + Quick link to book a short demo
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Khan <sara@acmedata.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Welcome — quick 20m to show how we reduce inference costs

Hi Sara —

Thanks for signing up for Redwood! I saw your org started a trial and I wanted to offer a quick 20-minute walkthrough to show how we typically help teams cut per-token costs and stabilize latency for production workloads. No heavy slides — focused on what would work with your current model and infra.

If that sounds useful, pick a slot here: https://calendly.com/redwood/jonas-30min (lots of morning availability this week). If you prefer, reply with 2-3 windows and I’ll set it up.

Why this call:
- Short checklist for trial success (sample prompts + config)
- Quick look at dedicated vs hosted fit for regulatory needs
- Next steps & a simple mutual action plan if you want to move forward

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Senior SDR, Redwood Inference
jonas@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198

--
Redwood Inference | Production-first LLM inference
From: Sara Khan <sara@acmedata.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Welcome — quick 20m to show how we reduce inference costs

Thanks Jonas — appreciate the quick outreach. We’re definitely interested; I’m the technical lead working on a PoC and would like our procurement person looped for contract questions. I can do Tuesday 12/1 between 10:00–11:30 PT or Wednesday 12/2 after 1pm PT. Also attaching a one-page summary of our priorities.

Sara Khan
Lead ML Engineer, Acme Data
sara@acmedata.com

Attachment: acme-prod-requirements.pdf (1 page)
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Khan <sara@acmedata.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 13:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Welcome — quick 20m to show how we reduce inference costs

Perfect — thanks for the windows, Sara. I’m booking Tuesday 12/1 10:30 PT which should give us 30 minutes to walk through the PoC items you attached. Calendly link (for your calendar invite + reschedule): https://calendly.com/redwood/jonas-30min/12-01-1030

Ben — looping you in as our solutions engineer so we can cover the model/quantization questions. Monica, I flagged this as likely a 2–4 week PoC — can you help with a brief MOP (mutual action plan) after the call?

Agenda (30m):
- 5m: Introductions + success criteria (Sara + procurement)
- 10m: Ben — technical fit for latency & quantization options
- 10m: Jonas/Monica — trial configuration and rollout plan
- 5m: Next steps / pricing / procurement touchpoints

See you Tuesday — invite sent from my calendar. If anything changes, use the Calendly link above to move it.

Thanks,
Jonas
Senior SDR, Redwood Inference
